_comment: sdlc-skills skill registry — canonical source for which skills exist and how to fetch them. Skills in the sdlc-skills monorepo carry `monorepo: sdlc-skills` + `name: <subdir>`. Third-party skill repos carry `repo: owner/repo` (+ optional `ref`, + optional `subdir` for multi-skill repos) and are fetched by `bin/init.mjs` via git clone, then copied into the project's skills dir (or symlinked with `--symlink`).
